meta.name: runbook
meta.description: Write an operating runbook from the delivered system and verified procedures. Use when the customer team or a successor needs to operate without the original engineer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把交付的系统整理成可交接、可照着做的运维操作手册
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目交付后要把运维步骤交给客户团队或接班的同事。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a delivered system into a handover-ready operations manual others can follow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're handing off operations to a client team or a successor.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会根据已交付的系统和已验证的流程,写出一份操作 runbook,让客户团队或接手人不必依赖原工程师也能运维。它先读任务上下文契约和方法文档,再动笔。
howto.when: 当客户团队或接手人需要在没有原工程师的情况下操作该系统时触发;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前已脱敏的数据包与范围,不重启已答过的设置与提问。

say.text: 根据已交付的系统和跑过的验证步骤,写一份操作 runbook。
say.note: 它会先读任务上下文契约和方法文档。

say.text: 接手人要独立运维这套系统,把部署和验收步骤写进 runbook。
say.note: 实现、验证、部署、验收会分开标注。

say.text: 这几个环节还没验证过,在 runbook 里如实标成未知。
say.note: 原文要求保留未知项,不猜测。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes an operating runbook from the delivered system and verified procedures, so a customer team or successor can operate without the original engineer. It first reads the task context contract and the method.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the customer team or a successor must operate the system without the original engineer. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope rather than restarting setup.

say_en.text: Write an operating runbook from the delivered system and our verified steps.
say_en.note: It reads the task context contract and method first.

say_en.text: A successor will run this system; put deployment and acceptance steps in the runbook.
say_en.note: Implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance stay distinct.

say_en.text: We haven't verified these steps yet, so mark them as unknown in the runbook.
